title: Connector declaration
description: One integration surface, as declared in packages/neterverse-kernel/src/connectors.ts and generated into the registry by `npm run connectors`. A DECLARATION ONLY: there is deliberately no field for a stored verification state or a last-verified date. Whether an observation is currently fresh is computed at runtime from .neterverse/live/ by `npm run bus -- connectors`. An earlier version of this schema required verification_state and last_verified, so every entry carried a claim that aged silently - and `bus status` printed a LIVE_VERIFIED count from values weeks out of date. additionalProperties is false, so those fields cannot come back by accident.

system_of_record_for.description: What this system is the authority for. Everything else about it is a projection.

freshness_minutes.description: How long an observation of this connector stays useful. A judgement about rate of change, not a guarantee. Past it the control plane reports STALE rather than presenting an old reading as current.

write_authorized.description: Whether the principal has authorized writes through this connector at all. Declarative: nothing in the kernel reads it to permit or refuse a write, and it is never blanket permission - a task still has to authorize the specific write. Per-connector verdicts and the actions each one may not take live in docs/CONNECTORS.md.
